name: Omni Studio · Approval email (configure SMTP before activation)

parameters.query: WITH reminders AS (INSERT INTO studio_automation_messages(plan_id,plan_version,recipient_user_id,recipient_email,kind) SELECT p.id,p.version,u.id,u.email,r.kind FROM publishing_plans p CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('approval_due_soon',(p.payload->>'scheduledAt')::timestamptz<=now()+interval '3 hours'),('approval_overdue',p.updated_at<=now()-interval '2 days')) r(kind,due) JOIN studio_users u ON u.workspace_id=1 AND u.active AND u.role IN ('admin','manager') AND u.email !~* '\.test$' WHERE p.status='pending' AND (p.payload->>'scheduledAt')::timestamptz>now() AND r.due ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING), stale AS (UPDATE studio_automation_messages m SET status='cancelled' WHERE m.status='queued' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM publishing_plans p WHERE p.id=m.plan_id AND p.version=m.plan_version AND p.status='pending') RETURNING m.id), claimed AS (UPDATE studio_automation_messages m SET status='sending',claimed_at=now() WHERE m.id IN (SELECT q.id FROM studio_automation_messages q JOIN publishing_plans p ON p.id=q.plan_id AND p.version=q.plan_version AND p.status='pending' WHERE q.status='queued' AND q.recipient_email !~* '\.test$' AND (p.payload->>'scheduledAt')::timestamptz>now() ORDER BY q.created_at FOR UPDATE OF q SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 20) RETURNING m.id,m.kind,m.recipient_email,m.plan_id) SELECT c.id,c.kind,c.recipient_email,c.plan_id,p.payload->>'name' AS plan_name,p.payload->>'scheduledAt' AS scheduled_at FROM claimed c JOIN publishing_plans p ON p.id=c.plan_id

parameters.subject: ={{ $json.kind === 'approval_requested' ? 'Bài viết cần duyệt: ' + $json.plan_name : 'Nhắc duyệt bài viết: ' + $json.plan_name }}
parameters.text:
={{ 'Bài viết: ' + $json.plan_name + '
Thời gian dự kiến (UTC): ' + $json.scheduled_at + '
Mở Omni Studio → Lịch nội dung → Chưa duyệt để xem và duyệt.
Mã kế hoạch: ' + $json.plan_id }}

parameters.query: UPDATE studio_automation_messages SET status='sent',sent_at=now() WHERE id='{{ $('Queue reminders and claim email').item.json.id }}'::uuid AND status='sending' RETURNING id
